title: 第8章  死字怎么写的！
content_zh:
“那又如何？难道你以为，陆烬真能杀了圣女不成？”
“这倒是，姬邀月峰主可不会眼睁睁看着自己爱徒被别人杀了，而且，圣女还是血月圣地赤月长老看中的人。”
“事到如今，事实真相已经不重要了，实力，才是一切的基础！”
“……”
听着周围议论声，柳如烟面如猪肝，恨的咬牙切齿。
几年来辛辛苦苦树立的形象，在这一刻，土崩瓦解！
“呵！万剑宗让你这道貌岸然的贱人做圣女，当真是滑天下之大稽！”
陆烬话落，九百飞剑再次冲出！
而第一波飞剑冲出之后，他体内灵气再次不要命的爆发出来，紧接着又是九百飞剑！
这一刻，全场哗然，所有人被震惊的彻底石化！
“这个陆烬，他疯了！”
“九百！又是九百飞剑！”
“简直恐怖！从未见过气息如此雄浑之人！”
“他简直不是人！”
“……”
所有人头皮发麻！
就连远处那紫阳门狂刀门等强者，此时也都被惊掉了下巴！
“这万剑宗内，出了个什么妖孽？”
“我认识他施展的武学，乃是万剑宗百剑斩，可就算在他们宗主楚天雄身上，本座都没见过如此登峰造极的百剑斩！”
“妖孽！此人今日若不死，他日必成一方巨擘！”

“为了此子，本座倒不介意趟一趟万剑宗的浑水！”
“本座也正有此意……”
“……”
此时，在观战之人后方，一道人影无声无息出现，而此人，正是之前从万剑宗禁地深处走出的宗主，楚天雄！
“好小子，总算没辜负你师尊对你的栽培，这般天赋，倒是有资格跟本座共谋大事！”
楚天雄看着将百剑斩施展得出神入化的陆烬，又低头摩挲了一阵手腕。
在他手腕上，赫然是一个月牙状印记，他眼眸深邃，不知在想些什么……
“区区五重灵珠境，你还胜不了我！”
九百飞剑再次席卷而来，柳如烟眸色阴沉，一口精血从嘴中喷出，没入黄金太阳剑内！
金光再次迸发，直接冲入铺天盖地席卷而来的飞剑大阵！
虚空震荡间，陆烬眸色森冷，口中却突然念动法诀！
“右手誓日，左手指月，阴阳交泰，焚烧一切罪孽，孽火镇狱……急急如律令！”
混乱战场中，忽然一道赤色火焰腾起。
当这赤火燃烧的瞬间，周围一切似忽然停滞！
“嗯？”
这一刻，柳如烟内心一颤，没来由生出一抹不好的预感。
她攻势骤然暴增，上百灵剑呼啸而下，杀意爆棚！
大地颤抖，虚空轰鸣，她的攻势，已然到达极致！
成片飞剑被斩碎，柳如烟战意澎湃，完全压制了陆烬的攻势！
当一把带着赤色火焰的剑影闪现的刹那，其所有攻势戛然而止！

孽火镇狱剑一出现，黄金太阳剑攻势便急转直下！
一声轰鸣响彻，当这两把剑对冲的瞬间，黄金太阳剑竟是直接爆炸而去！
“什么？这不可能！绝对不可能！”
柳如烟目光大骇，根本不相信陆烬能直接击爆自己的地阶战兵！
然而，在所有人那不可思议的目光里，孽火镇狱剑虚影早已冲破道道剑影，斩向柳如烟！
“噌！”
恐怖剑芒笼罩，柳如烟银牙紧咬，下一秒，至尊骨虚影直接冲出，迎风暴涨，要将孽火镇狱剑攻势阻挡！
至尊骨的力量，是她的最强杀手锏！
下一秒，一股诡异的臣服之感油然而生！
那至尊骨在爆发出磅礴灵力的瞬间，便被瞬间压制！
而她所有灵力的投入，像是打入了海绵之中，根本无法翻起波澜！
而孽火镇狱剑已然带着凛冽剑芒爆刺而来！
“狐师，救我！”
情急之下，柳如烟再次沟通神秘狐师。
可这一次，狐师并没有出现，反而那一直观战的姬邀月瞬间出现！
“孽障！”
姬邀月身形闪动，眨眼出现在柳如烟身前。
手臂一挥，一股灵气从袖袍中呼啸而出，孽火镇狱剑虚影速度锐减！
“还不束手就擒！”
姬邀月眸中蕴满杀意，却也颇为意外，自己一出手间竟没能将对方火剑虚影震碎！

“滚！”
陆烬一声暴喝，忽然孽火镇狱剑急转方向，竟是绕过姬邀月，再次对着柳如烟爆刺而去！
“什么！”
姬邀月惊了！
她没想到陆烬竟会如此顽固，更是没想到，他不过一道剑影，便拥有如此诡异能力！
“嘎嘣！”
柳如烟震惊之际，全身灵气逆冲，全部迎向孽火镇狱剑！
恐惧攫取心脏，她从未感受过，死亡距离自己这么近！
不错，这把剑影，让她感受到浓烈的死亡气息！
然而，孽火镇狱剑似乎锐不可当，哪怕她所有灵气全部反冲，依旧无法阻挡这把剑的攻势！
眼看剑影就要冲破所有防御之际！
“叮！”
姬邀月指间灵光闪过，一根玉簪直接击中剑影。
剑影被震偏，直接擦着柳如烟的脖颈激射而过，在那白皙的玉颈上留下一道血线！
下一秒，剑影直接轰入后方巨石，那巨石直接炸成漫天齑粉！
“咕嘟！”
这一刻，所有人喉结窜动，狂咽唾沫！
谁也没想到，就在刚刚，在姬邀月出手的情况下，陆烬差点要了柳如烟的命！
“我……我没事？”
柳如烟重重喘着粗气，摸着自己的脖颈，眼神惊恐得无以复加！

陆烬竟真的差点杀了她！
“嘎嘣！”
而此时的陆烬，看到那一剑竟没能杀死柳如烟，忍不住牙根一咬。
孽火镇狱剑威力巨大，虽只是一道剑影，却几乎抽空了他体内灵力！
加之之前，百剑斩的攻势他连番施展，体内灵力消耗极为严重！
不过，有葬天棺在，他很快便将一千灵石打入其中，消耗的灵力这才得以补充。
可一时间却无法恢复巅峰战力…
“孽障！当着本座的面，你要杀我爱徒！”
姬邀月看向陆烬，眼眸全是怒火！
“她身上的至尊骨，我已经证实是我的，你亲眼所见！”
“姬峰主，我三年前被陷害之事，如今已真相大白，所以，你还要继续保她么？”
陆烬声音冰冷道。
“你算个什么东西！也敢在我圣女峰杀人！”
姬邀月根本不给他说话的机会，“强闯圣女峰杀我弟子，陆烬，本座看你是不知道死字怎么写！”
姬邀月话音未落，手指一指，一股灵气直接于指间凝成一把青光长剑，刺向陆烬！
“星火剑！姬峰主竟动用星火剑斩杀他！”
“传闻姬峰主的星火剑只动用过十次，每次出鞘，必取人性命！”
“陆烬必死无疑！”
“……”
众人震惊，甚至连陆烬都眸色大变！

星火剑，地阶上乘战兵，比黄金太阳剑的等级还要高很多！
而且她六品金丹境修为，完全凌驾于陆烬之上，二人之间的差距宛若鸿沟！
“哼！”
陆烬冷哼一声，体内滚滚灵力再次凝聚，孽火镇狱剑剑影再次浮现！
这一剑出，他明显感觉身体开始发虚。
哪怕有葬天棺反哺灵力，可身体的急剧消耗，也有些吃不消！
但，坐以待毙不是他的性格！
虚空震荡，孽火镇狱剑眨眼与星火剑对撞到了一起！
剑吟响彻，尖锐刺耳！
而让所有人意外的是，孽火镇狱剑的一道虚影，竟能跟星火剑僵持几个呼吸！
“我的天！这个陆烬还能与六品金丹境的姬峰主抗衡？”
“匪夷所思！我甚至感觉自己在做梦！”
“若不是亲眼所见，根本没人会相信这是真的！”
“……”
众人愕然不已，那罗鹫等一众长老再次后心发凉！
难道陆烬这家伙遇强则强？
他的修为到底在什么层次？
众人震惊间，陆烬的孽火镇狱剑却在星火剑的绝对压制下，轰然爆碎！
六品金丹境太强大，哪怕陆烬身怀诸多手段，此时也完全不敌。
星火剑剑吟在耳畔响彻，那凛冽剑芒近在眼前，陆烬却并没有坐以待毙，大衍化龙诀所化龙膜瞬间凝聚于剑尖一点，要做出最后防御！

“好强的防御！只可惜，你实力太弱，根本无法发挥出这防御武学的最强水准！”
姬邀月眸色一变，浮现出一抹贪婪。
下一秒，长剑灵力暴增，龙膜防御上顿时裂开密密麻麻的裂痕！
“住手！”
而就在这一刻，一声喝止传来，那声音不大，却充满无上威严，让在场所有人头皮发麻！
“咻！”
一道人影无声无息落入场中，手掌轻抬，竟是赤手空拳，将姬邀月的星火剑抓在手里，然后像是拿开一件寻常之物般，将其丢到了一边！
“宗……宗主？”
姬邀月愕然，显然没想到，一向见不着面的宗主大人，会出现在这种场合！
而在场众人也全懵了，同样不会想到，连宗门大比都难得一见都宗主大人，竟突然出现了！
“你这防御也不错，本座甚是喜欢。”
楚天雄看向陆烬，手指一弹，竟是将那道龙膜凝聚的防御，直接弹碎而去！
而这一瞬，陆烬心头一震！
楚天雄略一出手，便让他感到此人高深莫测！
“宗主！此子残杀我宗长老与弟子，如今更是要杀害圣女，罪该万死！”
姬邀月见楚天雄看待陆烬的眼神充满喜色，黛眉皱起，冷生说道。
“此事本座知道。”
楚天雄微微点头：
“本座现在也知道了，陆烬在三年前就是被诬陷的，所以，今天的误会，到此结束。”
闻言，姬邀月一愣：

“宗主，此事可不能就这么过去！他可是杀了我万剑宗长老的，按我万剑宗宗规，当斩立决！”
闻言，楚天雄剑眉一挑：
“你的意思是，按规矩办，把柳如烟也一并杀了？”
content_en:
"So what? Do you think that Lu Jin can really kill the saint?"
"That's true. Master Ji Yaoyue Peak will not just watch his beloved disciple be killed by others. Moreover, the saint is also the person favored by Elder Chiyue of the Blood Moon Holy Land."
"At this point, the truth is no longer important. Strength is the foundation of everything!"
"..."
Listening to the comments around her, Liu Ruyan's face turned into pig liver, and she gnashed her teeth in hatred.
The image he had worked so hard to build over the past few years fell apart at this moment!
"Ha! The Wanjian Sect allows a sanctimonious bitch like you to become a saint. It's really the most ridiculous thing in the world!"
After Lu Jin finished speaking, the Nine Hundred Flying Swords rushed out again!
After the first wave of flying swords rushed out, the spiritual energy in his body burst out again, followed by nine hundred flying swords!
At this moment, the whole place was in an uproar, and everyone was completely petrified by shock!
"This Lu Jin, he's crazy!"
"Nine hundred! Another nine hundred flying swords!"
"It's absolutely terrifying! I've never seen anyone with such a powerful aura!"
"He is simply not human!"
"..."
Everyone's scalp is numb!
Even the powerful men from the Ziyang Clan and the Crazy Sword Clan in the distance were shocked at this moment!
"What kind of evildoer has appeared in the Wanjian Sect?"
"I know that the martial arts he performs is the Hundred Swords Slash of the Ten Thousand Swords Sect, but even in their sect leader Chu Tianxiong, I have never seen such a peak Hundred Swords Slash!"
"Monster! If this person doesn't die today, he will become a giant one day!"
"For this son, I don't mind taking a trip into the muddy waters of Wanjian Sect!"
"I also have this intention..."
"..."
At this time, behind the people watching the battle, a figure appeared silently, and this person was none other than the sect leader Chu Tianxiong who had walked out from the depths of the Wanjian Sect's forbidden area before!
"Good boy, you have finally lived up to your master's cultivation. With such a talent, you are qualified to conspire with me on big things!"
Chu Tianxiong looked at Lu Jin who was performing the Hundred Sword Cut to perfection, and then lowered his head and rubbed his wrist for a while.
On his wrist, there is a crescent-shaped mark. His eyes are deep, and he doesn't know what he is thinking...
"You can't beat me even though you're only at the fifth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm!"
The Nine Hundred Flying Swords swept over again, Liu Ruyan's eyes were gloomy, a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth, and was submerged into the Golden Sun Sword!
Golden light burst out again, rushing directly into the overwhelming flying sword formation!
As the void shook, Lu Jin's eyes were cold, but he suddenly chanted the magic formula in his mouth!
"The right hand swears to the sun, the left hand points to the moon, the yin and yang are harmonious, burn all sins, and the evil fire suppresses the prison... Be as urgent as the law!"
In the chaotic battlefield, a red flame suddenly rose.
When the red fire burned, everything around seemed to suddenly stop!
"Huh?"
At this moment, Liu Ruyan's heart trembled, and she had a bad feeling for no reason.
Her offensive suddenly increased, hundreds of spirit swords roared down, and the murderous intent was overwhelming!
The earth trembled, the void roared, her offensive had reached its extreme!
Pieces of flying swords were chopped into pieces, and Liu Ruyan was full of fighting spirit, completely suppressing Lu Jin's offensive!
The moment a sword with red flames flashed, all its attacks came to an abrupt end!
As soon as the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword appeared, the Golden Sun Sword's offensive took a turn for the worse!
A roar resounded, and the moment the two swords collided, the Golden Sun Sword exploded directly!
"What? This is impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
Liu Ruyan's eyes were horrified, she didn't believe that Lu Jin could directly blow up his earth-level soldiers!
However, in everyone's incredible eyes, the phantom of the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword had already broken through the sword shadows and slashed towards Liu Ruyan!
"Oops!"
The terrifying sword light shrouded her, Liu Ruyan clenched her silver teeth, and the next second, the Supreme Bone Shadow rushed out directly, facing the rising storm, trying to block the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword's offensive!
The power of the Supreme Bone is her strongest weapon!
The next second, a strange feeling of surrender arose spontaneously!
That supreme boneThe moment the majestic spiritual power burst out, it was instantly suppressed!
And all her spiritual energy invested was like being soaked into a sponge, unable to make waves at all!
And the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword has already burst forward with a fierce sword light!
"Master Fox, save me!"
In desperation, Liu Ruyan contacted the mysterious fox master again.
But this time, Master Fox did not appear. Instead, Ji Yaoyue, who had been watching the battle, appeared instantly!
"Evil!"
Ji Yaoyue's figure flashed and appeared in front of Liu Ruyan in the blink of an eye.
With a wave of his arm, a stream of spiritual energy roared out from the sleeve robe, and the speed of the phantom of the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword dropped sharply!
"I'm going to capture you without mercy!"
Ji Yaoyue's eyes were filled with murderous intent, but she was also quite surprised that she failed to shatter the opponent's flaming sword shadow into pieces with just one move!
"Get out!"
Lu Jin shouted loudly, and suddenly the Evil Fire Prison Suppressing Sword suddenly turned around, bypassed Ji Yaoyue, and stabbed Liu Ruyan again!
"What!"
Ji Yaoyue was shocked!
She didn't expect Lu Jin to be so stubborn, and she didn't expect that he could have such weird abilities with just a sword shadow!
"Crack!"
When Liu Ruyan was shocked, all her spiritual energy rushed forward, facing the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword!
Fear gripped her heart. She had never felt that death was so close to her!
Yes, the shadow of this sword made her feel the strong aura of death!
However, the Evil Fire Prison Sword seems to be unstoppable. Even if all her spiritual energy recoils, she still cannot stop the sword's offensive!
Just when the sword shadow is about to break through all defenses!
"Ding!"
A flash of light flashed between Ji Yaoyue's fingers, and a hosta directly hit the sword shadow.
The sword shadow was deflected, grazing Liu Ruyan's neck, leaving a line of blood on the white jade neck!
The next second, the sword shadow directly hit the boulder behind, and the boulder exploded into powder all over the sky!
"Gudu!"
At this moment, everyone's Adam's apple was twitching and they were swallowing saliva!
No one expected that just now, when Ji Yaoyue took action, Lu Jin almost killed Liu Ruyan!
"I...I'm okay?"
Liu Ruyan gasped heavily and touched her neck, her eyes extremely frightened!
Lu Jin actually almost killed her!
"Crack!"
At this time, Lu Jin couldn't help biting his teeth when he saw that the sword failed to kill Liu Ruyan.
The Evil Fire Prison Suppressing Sword was extremely powerful. Although it was just a sword shadow, it almost drained the spiritual energy from his body!
In addition, he had repeatedly used the Hundred Sword Slash offensives before, and the spiritual energy in his body was extremely consumed!
However, with the Sky Burial Coffin there, he quickly poured a thousand spiritual stones into it, and the consumed spiritual energy was replenished.
But he couldn't regain his peak combat power for a while...
"Evil! In front of me, you want to kill my beloved disciple!"
Ji Yaoyue looked at Lu Jin, her eyes full of anger!
"I have confirmed that the Supreme Bone on her body is mine, you can see it with your own eyes!"
"Master Ji Peak, the truth about me being framed three years ago has now been revealed, so do you want to continue to protect her?"
Lu Jin said in a cold voice.
"Who do you think you are! You dare to kill people on our Saintess Peak!"
Ji Yaoyue didn't give him a chance to speak at all, "Force the Saintess' Peak to kill my disciple, Lu Jin, I think you don't know how to write the word "death"!"
Before Ji Yaoyue finished speaking, she pointed her finger, and a stream of spiritual energy condensed directly between her fingers into a blue light sword and stabbed Lu Jin!
"Starfire Sword! Master Ji used the Starfire Sword to kill him!"
"It is rumored that Peak Master Ji's Spark Sword has only been used ten times. Every time it is unsheathed, it will kill someone!"
"Lu Jin will definitely die!"
"..."
Everyone was shocked, even Lu Jin’s eyes changed drastically!
The Starfire Sword is a superior warrior on the earth level, much higher than the Golden Sun Sword!
Moreover, her sixth-grade Golden Core cultivation level was completely superior to Lu Jin's, and the gap between them was like a chasm!
"Hmph!"
Lu Jin snorted coldly, the rolling spiritual power in his body condensed again, and the shadow of the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword appeared again!As soon as the sword was released, he clearly felt that his body was starting to feel weak.
Even if there is a burial coffin to feed back spiritual power, the rapid consumption of the body is still too much!
However, it is not his character to sit still and wait for death!
The void shook, and the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword collided with the Starfire Sword in the blink of an eye!
The sword chant was loud and sharp!
What surprised everyone was that the shadow of the Evil Fire Suppressing Prison Sword was able to hold on to the Star Fire Sword for a few breaths!
"Oh my God! Can this Lu Jin compete with Peak Master Ji who is in the sixth-grade golden elixir realm?"
"It's incredible! I even feel like I'm dreaming!"
“No one would believe this is true if they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes!”
"..."
Everyone was stunned, and Luo Jiu and other elders felt chilled again!
Could it be that this guy Lu Jin becomes stronger when he is strong?
What level is his cultivation level at?
When everyone was shocked, Lu Jin's Evil Fire Prison Suppressing Sword exploded into pieces under the absolute suppression of the Star Fire Sword!
The sixth-grade golden elixir realm is too powerful. Even if Lu Jin has many tricks, he is completely unbeatable at this time.
The chant of the Star Fire Sword resounded in his ears, and the fierce sword light was close in front of him, but Lu Jin did not sit still and wait for death. The dragon membrane formed by the Dayan Dragon Transformation Technique instantly condensed on the tip of the sword, and he wanted to make a final defense!
"What a strong defense! It's a pity that you are too weak and cannot display the strongest level of this defensive martial arts!"
Ji Yaoyue's eyes changed, and a hint of greed emerged.
The next second, the spiritual power of the long sword increased sharply, and dense cracks suddenly opened in the defense of the dragon film!
"Stop!"
And at this moment, a shout came. The voice was not loud, but it was full of supreme majesty, making everyone present feel numb!
"Phew!"
A figure fell into the field silently. He raised his hand slightly and grabbed Ji Yaoyue's Starfire Sword with his bare hands, and then threw it aside as if taking away an ordinary object!
"Zong...sect leader?"
Ji Yaoyue was stunned. She obviously didn't expect that the sect leader, who was never seen in person, would appear on such an occasion!
Everyone present was also stunned. They also didn't expect that the sect master, who was rarely seen even in the sect competition, would suddenly appear!
"Your defense is not bad, I like it very much."
Chu Tianxiong looked at Lu Jin, and with a flick of his finger, the defense condensed by the dragon film was directly blown away!
At this moment, Lu Jin was shocked!
As soon as Chu Tianxiong made a move, he felt that this person was unpredictable!
"Sect Master! This man slaughtered the elders and disciples of our sect, and now he wants to kill the saint. He deserves death!"
Ji Yaoyue saw Chu Tianxiong's eyes full of joy when looking at Lu Jin, her eyebrows furrowed, and she said Leng Sheng.
"I know this."
Chu Tianxiong nodded slightly:
"I now know that Lu Jin was framed three years ago, so today's misunderstanding ends here."
Hearing this, Ji Yaoyue was stunned:
